## Nuvio 5: AI that gets things done

Nuvio 5 is here, and it's about taking routine work off your plate. The assistant inside Nuvio can now take action as well as answer questions. With Nuvio MCP, you can also connect the AI agent you already use, such as ChatGPT, Claude or Grok Bot, and what it does lands right in Nuvio. Bank reconnects are also easier, overdraft balances now match your bank, and long scanned invoices keep every line.

### Run Nuvio from the AI agent you already use [...] ### Run Nuvio from the AI agent you already use

Connect ChatGPT, Claude (the app or Claude Code) or Grok Bot to Nuvio and ask it to handle the everyday tasks: add an expense, create a customer, record a payment or match a bank transaction to an invoice. When you connect, you sign in with your Nuvio account and choose which company the agent works in. The agent can only do what your role allows, and a built-in safeguard stops it from saving the same entry twice by accident. To set it up, go to Settings > Profile > AI agents. That page walks you through each agent step by step and lists every agent you've connected, with its company, when it was last used and a Disconnect button.

### Your Nuvio assistant can now get things done [...] ### A redesigned income and expense flow

Creating and editing income and expenses is rebuilt from the ground up. Pick Easy or Advanced entry, enter the amount, view your receipt side by side, and save from a sticky bar that stays put as you work.

### Nuvio AI, rebuilt

The AI chat has a new interface with searchable history, a redesigned session sidebar, one-click copy, and credit usage tracking. Ask questions about your finances in plain language and get answers from an upgraded model.

### Collaborate on any entry

Leave comment threads on income and expense records so your team can discuss a transaction without switching to email or Slack.

# Finance Admin Is a Natural Fit for AI Agents

## Finance and AI Agents

Miloš Radić
Finance Admin Is a Natural Fit for AI Agents

AI agents are often talked about as if the ceiling keeps moving: more autonomy, more decisions, more work taken off people’s plates. But in finance, the more realistic opportunity may be a little more boring. The work worth handing off to AI might be recurring admin around decisions: work that follows rules, creates a record, and can be reviewed before anything important happens. [...] The research backs this: invoice templates were among the finance tasks respondents said they wanted agents to handle. Much of the work depends on information that already exists somewhere in the business, which then needs to be pulled into a format that a human can review.

The point is not to hand the invoice over completely. It is to get the draft into a reviewable shape before the human step begins. If an agent can assemble the first version and leave the finance lead or account owner to check the judgment calls, it has already done useful work.

## A Second Set of Eyes Before the Invoice Goes Out [...] Respondents were specific here. They wanted agents to send payment reminders in accordance with predefined rules. The comfort comes from having clear boundaries around the work.

Payment follow-up sits close to the relationship, so those boundaries matter. A useful agent can keep routine reminders moving, but when the situation calls for context, judgment, or care, a person should still step in.

## AI Agents May Earn Their Place in the Work Around the Work

The finance tasks people named all sit in the same uncomfortable place: close enough to money to matter, but structured enough to check. They help a team invoice cleanly, review confidently, and follow up without letting administration pile up.
